title: He Ran a Top Lady Gaga Fan Page. Then He Vanished.
summary_full: Kirill Nguyen, the founder of Gaga Daily, said he had been imprisoned in Belarus for participating in pro-democracy protests. He resurfaced this week after an absence of more than two years.
